title: Home practical guide and safety card: red cabbage indicator
subject: Science (GCSE Biology, Chemistry, Physics)
unit: Spring 2: Transport, the periodic table and waves
source: Written for gcse-science/y10 lesson 48 (Home practical guide and safety card: red cabbage indicator (portal worksheet; adult handles hot water; no cleaning products))
intro: Lesson 48: Acids, alkalis, indicators and pH. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To make an indicator from red cabbage and test kitchen liquids
equipment: Lemon juice, vinegar, bicarbonate of soda solution, soapy water (no bleach or cleaning products)
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: An adult chops the cabbage and pours hot water over it
Leave for 10 minutes, then sieve the purple liquid
Pour a little into each cup
Add a few drops of one test liquid to each
Sort: acid (pink or red), neutral (purple), alkali (green or blue)

questions.q: Big question: what idea do sting remedies use?
questions.a: Neutralisation: an alkali cancels an acid, an acid cancels an alkali.
